```{r config}
# ==============================================================================
# 1.1 USER-EDITABLE PATHS AND IDENTIFIERS

# USER: edit these for your local environment.
PROJECT_ROOT    <- "C:/Code/UG_ERP_Project"
EXPERIMENT_ID   <- "E2"               # "E1" or "E2"
ANALYSIS_METHOD <- "Method_Standard"  # cluster perm uses Standard baseline pipeline

# Path to upstream trials.csv from the Regression pipeline (for caption N).
# Note: although cluster perm uses Standard pipeline, N is identical across

                        paste0("02_Pipeline_Output_", EXPERIMENT_ID),

# Permutation count from upstream pipeline (hu-neuro-pipeline default = 1024).
N_PERM <- 1024

# Time-bin width (ms) for Panel C dynamic difference topographies.
# Adaptive to cluster duration: longer cluster -> wider bins to keep panel count
```

# 2. Caption Metadata Loader

```{r caption-metadata}
# ==============================================================================
# Loads upstream trials.csv to derive N (subject count) for caption metadata.
# Falls back to placeholder if missing so the script still runs.
# ==============================================================================
load_caption_metadata <- function(trials_csv_path) {
  default_meta <- list(n_subjects = NA_integer_,
                       n_trials_total = NA_integer_,
                       source_status = "MISSING")

  if (!file.exists(trials_csv_path)) {
    warning(sprintf("trials.csv not found at: %s\nCaption N fields will be left as 'NA'.",
                    trials_csv_path))
    return(default_meta)
  }

  df_trials <- tryCatch(read_csv(trials_csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE),
                        error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(df_trials)) return(default_meta)

  id_candidates <- c("participant_id", "subject", "subj", "id", "subject_id")
  id_col <- intersect(id_candidates, names(df_trials))[1]
  if (is.na(id_col)) return(default_meta)

  meta <- list(
    n_subjects     = dplyr::n_distinct(df_trials[[id_col]]),
    n_trials_total = nrow(df_trials),
    source_status  = "OK"
  )
  cat(sprintf("[Caption metadata] N = %d subjects, %d total trials retained.\n",
              meta$n_subjects, meta$n_trials_total))
  meta
}

CAPTION_META <- load_caption_metadata(TRIALS_CSV)
```

# 3. Helper Functions

```{r helpers}
# ==============================================================================
# Channel whitelist: anything not in channel_locations.csv (component scalars,
# baseline scalars, A2 reference, query strings, label) is excluded from
# topographic rendering.
# ==============================================================================
load_channel_whitelist <- function(input_dir) {
  chan_file <- file.path(input_dir, "channel_locations.csv")
  if (!file.exists(chan_file)) {
    stop(sprintf("channel_locations.csv missing at: %s", chan_file))
  }
  read_csv(chan_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    rename(electrode = channel)
}

# ==============================================================================
# Symmetric color limits: data-driven 99th-percentile cap with stepped rounding.
# Used for both t-value maps and uV difference maps with appropriate step tables.
# ==============================================================================
compute_limits <- function(values, kind = c("voltage", "tvalue")) {
  kind <- match.arg(kind)
  if (all(is.na(values))) return(c(-0.1, 0.1))

  cap <- quantile(abs(values), probs = 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.infinite(cap) || cap == 0) return(c(-0.1, 0.1))

  step <- if (kind == "voltage") {
    if (cap <= 0.5) 0.05 else if (cap <= 1.0) 0.1 else if (cap <= 2.5) 0.25 else 0.5
  } else {
    if (cap <= 1.0) 0.25 else if (cap <= 3.0) 0.5 else if (cap <= 6.0) 1.0 else 2.0
  }
  cap <- ceiling(cap / step) * step
  if (cap == 0) cap <- step
  c(-cap, cap)
}

# ==============================================================================
# Resolve the contrast string into two condition labels.
# Defensive: validates both labels exist in df_grand$label.
# ==============================================================================
parse_contrast <- function(contrast_name, df_grand) {
  conds <- str_split(contrast_name, "\\s*-\\s*", simplify = TRUE)[1, ]
  if (length(conds) != 2) {
    stop(sprintf("Cannot parse contrast '%s' into two condition names.", contrast_name))
  }
  cond1 <- conds[1]
  cond2 <- conds[2]
  available <- unique(df_grand$label)
  missing <- setdiff(c(cond1, cond2), available)
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    stop(sprintf("Contrast condition(s) absent in grand_ave.csv: %s",
                 paste(missing, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  list(cond1 = cond1, cond2 = cond2)
}

# ==============================================================================
# Per-cluster summary: spatiotemporal extent and statistics.
# Used both for layout decisions and for caption text.
# ==============================================================================
summarise_cluster <- function(df_stats, contrast_name, cluster_id) {
  sub <- df_stats %>%
    filter(contrast == contrast_name, cluster == cluster_id) %>%
    mutate(time_ms = round(time * 1000))
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) return(NULL)

  list(
    cluster_id = cluster_id,
    p_val      = unique(sub$p_val)[1],
    t_min_ms   = min(sub$time_ms),
    t_max_ms   = max(sub$time_ms),
    n_chans    = dplyr::n_distinct(sub$channel),
    chans      = sort(unique(sub$channel)),
    mean_t     = mean(sub$t_obs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sign       = if (str_detect(cluster_id, "^pos")) "positive" else "negative"
  )
}
```

# 4. Core Visualization Engine

```{r viz-engine}
# ==============================================================================
# Renders one figure per contrast, combining all significant clusters within
# that contrast (typically pos_1 + neg_1 forming a dipolar topography).
#
# Three panels:
#   A. Difference wave averaged across electrodes belonging to each cluster,
#      with cluster temporal extent shaded. Multiple cluster traces overlaid
#      in distinct colors. No CI ribbon (grand_ave.csv has no participant_id).
#   B. uV difference topography averaged across the union of all cluster time
#      windows. Cluster electrodes highlighted with cluster-specific markers.
#   C. Temporal evolution of the uV difference topography across the union
#      time window, in adaptive bins. Cluster electrodes highlighted per-bin.
#
# Caption embeds: N, n_perm, all cluster p-values and extents, and the
# cluster-level inference disclaimer (Sassenhagen & Draschkow, 2019).
# ==============================================================================

plot_cluster_figure <- function(df_grand, df_stats, contrast_name,
                                cluster_ids, chanlocs, out_dir) {

  # --- Resolve conditions and per-cluster summaries -------------------------
  conds <- parse_contrast(contrast_name, df_grand)
  cond1 <- conds$cond1
  cond2 <- conds$cond2

  cluster_summaries <- purrr::map(cluster_ids,
                                  ~summarise_cluster(df_stats, contrast_name, .x))
  cluster_summaries <- compact(cluster_summaries)
  if (length(cluster_summaries) == 0) {
    warning(sprintf("No valid clusters for contrast %s. Skipping.", contrast_name))
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Union time window across all clusters in this contrast.
  union_tmin <- min(map_dbl(cluster_summaries, "t_min_ms"))
  union_tmax <- max(map_dbl(cluster_summaries, "t_max_ms"))

  # --- Restrict df_grand to cond1/cond2 and EEG channels only ---------------
  eeg_whitelist <- chanlocs$electrode
  eeg_cols_present <- intersect(eeg_whitelist, names(df_grand))

  df_erp <- df_grand %>%
    filter(label %in% c(cond1, cond2)) %>%
    select(time, label, all_of(eeg_cols_present)) %>%
    mutate(time_ms = round(time * 1000))

  # --- Per-cluster, per-time difference wave averaged across cluster chans --
  # Vectorized: for each cluster, mean uV across cluster's electrodes per time
  # per condition; then cond1 - cond2.
  df_panel_a <- map_dfr(cluster_summaries, function(clu) {
    chans_in <- intersect(clu$chans, eeg_cols_present)
    if (length(chans_in) == 0) return(NULL)

    df_erp %>%
      select(time_ms, label, all_of(chans_in)) %>%
      pivot_longer(all_of(chans_in), names_to = "electrode", values_to = "uV") %>%
      group_by(time_ms, label) %>%
      summarise(uV = mean(uV, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = label, values_from = uV) %>%
      mutate(diff = !!sym(cond1) - !!sym(cond2),
             cluster_id = clu$cluster_id,
             cluster_sign = clu$sign)
  })

  if (nrow(df_panel_a) == 0) {
    warning(sprintf("No EEG-valid cluster channels for contrast %s.", contrast_name))
    return(NULL)
  }

  # --- Color mapping: positive clusters red, negative blue -----------------
  cluster_colors <- setNames(
    map_chr(cluster_summaries, function(clu) {
      if (clu$sign == "positive") "#D62828" else "#0077B6"
    }),
    map_chr(cluster_summaries, "cluster_id")
  )

  # ============================================================================
  # PANEL A: Difference wave per cluster, with shaded cluster windows
  # ============================================================================
  # Build shaded-region data for each cluster.
  shade_df <- map_dfr(cluster_summaries, function(clu) {
    tibble(cluster_id = clu$cluster_id,
           xmin = clu$t_min_ms, xmax = clu$t_max_ms,
           fill_color = cluster_colors[clu$cluster_id])
  })

  panel_A <- ggplot() +
    # Cluster temporal extents as semi-transparent bands.
    geom_rect(data = shade_df,
              aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
                  fill = cluster_id),
              alpha = 0.12, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, color = "black") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, color = "black") +
    geom_line(data = df_panel_a,
              aes(x = time_ms, y = diff, color = cluster_id),
              linewidth = 1.1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors,
                       name = "Cluster (electrode set)") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors, guide = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
    labs(title = sprintf("A. Difference wave: %s minus %s", cond1, cond2),
         subtitle = "Averaged across electrodes belonging to each cluster",
         x = "Time (ms)",
         y = "Amplitude difference (\u00b5V)") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey30"),
          axis.title    = element_text(size = 11),
          axis.text     = element_text(size = 10),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.box = "horizontal",
          legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
          legend.text  = element_text(size = 9))

  # ============================================================================
  # PANEL B: uV difference topography averaged across union cluster window
  # ============================================================================
  df_diff_topo_B <- df_erp %>%
    filter(time_ms >= union_tmin & time_ms <= union_tmax) %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(eeg_cols_present),
                 names_to = "electrode", values_to = "uV") %>%
    group_by(label, electrode) %>%
    summarise(uV = mean(uV, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = label, values_from = uV) %>%
    mutate(amplitude = !!sym(cond1) - !!sym(cond2))

  diff_limits_B <- compute_limits(df_diff_topo_B$amplitude, kind = "voltage")

  # Highlight all electrodes ever participating in any cluster of this contrast.
  all_cluster_chans <- unique(unlist(map(cluster_summaries, "chans")))

  panel_B <- topoplot(df_diff_topo_B,
                      chan_locs = chanlocs,
                      quantity = "amplitude",
                      interp_limit = "head",
                      contour = TRUE,
                      limits = diff_limits_B,
                      palette = "RdBu",
                      points = TRUE,
                      highlights = all_cluster_chans) +
    labs(title = sprintf("B. Difference topography (%d-%d ms)",
                         union_tmin, union_tmax),
         subtitle = "Cluster electrodes highlighted") +
    theme(plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0.5),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey30", hjust = 0.5)) +
    guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title = "Diff (\u00b5V)",
                                 barheight = unit(4.5, "cm"),
                                 barwidth  = unit(0.5, "cm")))

  # ============================================================================
  # PANEL C: Temporal evolution of uV difference topography
  # ============================================================================
  union_duration <- union_tmax - union_tmin
  adaptive_step <- max(50, ceiling(union_duration / TARGET_PANEL_C_BINS / 10) * 10)
  bins <- seq(union_tmin, union_tmax, by = adaptive_step)
  if (max(bins) < union_tmax) bins <- c(bins, union_tmax)

  # Pre-compute the long-format difference per electrode per time-ms.
  df_diff_long <- df_erp %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(eeg_cols_present),
                 names_to = "electrode", values_to = "uV") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = label, values_from = uV) %>%
    mutate(amplitude = !!sym(cond1) - !!sym(cond2)) %>%
    select(time_ms, electrode, amplitude)

  # Use a single shared scale across all time bins (computed across the union
  # window so all panels in row C are directly comparable).
  diff_scan_C <- df_diff_long %>%
    filter(time_ms >= union_tmin & time_ms <= union_tmax)
  diff_limits_C <- compute_limits(diff_scan_C$amplitude, kind = "voltage")

  # Per-bin cluster-electrode set (across all clusters in this contrast).
  bin_chan_lookup <- function(b_min, b_max) {
    df_stats %>%
      filter(contrast == contrast_name,
             cluster %in% cluster_ids) %>%
      mutate(time_ms = round(time * 1000)) %>%
      filter(time_ms >= b_min & time_ms < b_max) %>%
      pull(channel) %>% unique()
  }

  dyn_plots <- purrr::map(seq_len(length(bins) - 1), function(i) {
    b_min <- bins[i]
    b_max <- bins[i + 1]

    df_slice <- df_diff_long %>%
      filter(time_ms >= b_min & time_ms < b_max) %>%
      group_by(electrode) %>%
      summarise(amplitude = mean(amplitude, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

    bin_chans <- bin_chan_lookup(b_min, b_max)
    hl_chans  <- if (length(bin_chans) > 0) bin_chans else NULL

    topoplot(df_slice, chan_locs = chanlocs,
             quantity = "amplitude", interp_limit = "head",
             contour = FALSE, limits = diff_limits_C, palette = "RdBu",
             points = TRUE, highlights = hl_chans) +
      labs(title = sprintf("%d-%d ms", round(b_min), round(b_max))) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, face = "plain"),
            legend.position = "none")
  })

  # Shared colorbar for Panel C row.
  dummy_df <- df_diff_long %>%
    filter(time_ms >= union_tmin & time_ms <= union_tmax) %>%
    slice(seq_len(min(50, n())))

  dummy_p <- topoplot(dummy_df, chan_locs = chanlocs,
                      quantity = "amplitude",
                      limits = diff_limits_C, palette = "RdBu") +
    guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title = "Diff (\u00b5V)",
                                 barheight = unit(4.0, "cm"),
                                 barwidth  = unit(0.5, "cm")))
  dyn_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(dummy_p)

  panel_C_row <- patchwork::wrap_plots(dyn_plots, nrow = 1) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title = "C. Difference topography evolution",
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13))
    )

  # ============================================================================
  # CAPTION CONSTRUCTION
  # ============================================================================
  n_str <- if (is.na(CAPTION_META$n_subjects)) "[N pending]"
           else sprintf("N = %d", CAPTION_META$n_subjects)

  cluster_lines <- map_chr(cluster_summaries, function(clu) {
    sprintf("  %s cluster (%s): %d-%d ms across %d electrodes; cluster-level p = %.4f",
            clu$sign, clu$cluster_id, clu$t_min_ms, clu$t_max_ms,
            clu$n_chans, clu$p_val)
  })

  caption_text <- paste0(
    sprintf("Cluster-based permutation test, contrast: %s (E%s, %s, %d permutations).\n",
            contrast_name, str_extract(EXPERIMENT_ID, "\\d"), n_str, N_PERM),
    paste(cluster_lines, collapse = "\n"), "\n",
    "Cluster-forming threshold p < 0.05, two-tailed. Difference topography in panels B and C ",
    "displays Cond1 - Cond2 in microvolts; highlighted electrodes participated in the ",
    "respective cluster. Cluster-based permutation provides cluster-level inference: ",
    "the test indicates that the observed cluster mass is unlikely under the null. ",
    "Precise temporal and spatial boundaries should be interpreted as approximate ",
    "(Sassenhagen & Draschkow, 2019, Psychophysiology).\n",
    "Note: cluster permutation here uses traditional pre-stimulus baseline subtraction ",
    "(Standard pipeline); main analyses use mean-centered baseline as covariate (Alday, 2019)."
  )

  # ============================================================================
  # MASTER ASSEMBLY
  # ============================================================================
  top_row    <- panel_A | panel_B
  bottom_row <- panel_C_row | dyn_legend

  cluster_p_str <- map_chr(cluster_summaries,
                           ~sprintf("%s p=%.4f", .x$cluster_id, .x$p_val)) %>%
    paste(collapse = " | ")

  final_plot <- top_row / bottom_row +
    patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.6)) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title    = sprintf("Cluster-based Permutation: %s", contrast_name),
      subtitle = cluster_p_str,
      caption  = str_wrap(caption_text, width = 130),
      theme = theme(
        plot.title    = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey30"),
        plot.caption  = element_text(size = 8.5, hjust = 0, color = "grey25",
                                     margin = margin(t = 14))
      )
    )

  # ============================================================================
  # EXPORT: PNG + PDF + values.csv
  # ============================================================================
  safe_contrast <- contrast_name %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s*-\\s*", "_minus_") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s+", "_")

  fig_width  <- max(12, 4 + length(dyn_plots) * 1.8)
  fig_height <- 11

  base_name <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("Cluster_", safe_contrast))
  ggsave(paste0(base_name, ".png"), final_plot,
         width = fig_width, height = fig_height, dpi = 300, bg = "white",
         limitsize = FALSE)
  ggsave(paste0(base_name, ".pdf"), final_plot, device = cairo_pdf,
         width = fig_width, height = fig_height, limitsize = FALSE)

  # Values CSVs for replotting.
  write_csv(df_panel_a,       paste0(base_name, "_panelA_values.csv"))
  write_csv(df_diff_topo_B,   paste0(base_name, "_panelB_values.csv"))
  write_csv(df_diff_long %>%
              filter(time_ms >= union_tmin & time_ms <= union_tmax),
            paste0(base_name, "_panelC_values.csv"))

  cat(sprintf("[Export] Contrast %s: figure + values written to %s\n",
              contrast_name, out_dir))
  invisible(final_plot)
}
```

# 5. Execution

```{r execution}
# ==============================================================================
# 5.1 LOCATE STATISTICAL FILES
# ==============================================================================
possible_stats_files <- c("clusters.csv", "perm.csv")
stats_file <- NULL
for (fname in possible_stats_files) {
  candidate <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, fname)
  if (file.exists(candidate)) { stats_file <- candidate; break }
}
grand_file <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "grand_ave.csv")

if (is.null(stats_file)) {
  cat("[Diagnostic] Cannot find statistical output ('clusters.csv' or 'perm.csv').\n")
  cat("Files in INPUT_DIR:\n"); print(list.files(INPUT_DIR))
  stop("Halted: missing cluster statistics file.")
}
if (!file.exists(grand_file)) {
  cat("[Diagnostic] Cannot find ERP waveform data ('grand_ave.csv').\n")
  cat("Files in INPUT_DIR:\n"); print(list.files(INPUT_DIR))
  stop("Halted: missing grand_ave.csv.")
}

cat(sprintf("[Status] Files verified.\n  Stats: %s\n  Grand: %s\n",
            basename(stats_file), basename(grand_file)))

# ==============================================================================
# 5.2 LOAD DATA
# ==============================================================================
df_stats <- read_csv(stats_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
df_grand <- read_csv(grand_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
chanlocs <- load_channel_whitelist(INPUT_DIR)

# Sanity probe: cluster summary table before any plotting.
cluster_probe <- df_stats %>%
  filter(p_val < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(time_ms = round(time * 1000)) %>%
  group_by(contrast, cluster) %>%
  summarise(t_min_ms = min(time_ms),
            t_max_ms = max(time_ms),
            n_chans  = dplyr::n_distinct(channel),
            mass_abs_t = sum(abs(t_obs)),
            p_val    = first(p_val),
            .groups  = "drop")

cat("\n=== Significant cluster summary ===\n")
print(cluster_probe, n = Inf)

if (nrow(cluster_probe) == 0) {
  cat("\n[Status] No significant clusters at alpha = 0.05. Nothing to render.\n")
} else {

  # ============================================================================
  # 5.3 RENDER ONE FIGURE PER CONTRAST (POS + NEG CLUSTERS COMBINED)
  # ============================================================================
  unique_contrasts <- df_sig <- cluster_probe %>%
    distinct(contrast) %>% pull(contrast)

  cat(sprintf("\n[Status] Rendering %d contrast(s)...\n", length(unique_contrasts)))

  for (contrast_name in unique_contrasts) {
    cluster_ids_in_contrast <- cluster_probe %>%
      filter(contrast == contrast_name) %>%
      pull(cluster)

    cat(sprintf("\n---> Contrast: %s | clusters: %s\n",
                contrast_name,
                paste(cluster_ids_in_contrast, collapse = ", ")))

    tryCatch({
      plot_cluster_figure(df_grand     = df_grand,
                          df_stats     = df_stats,
                          contrast_name = contrast_name,
                          cluster_ids  = cluster_ids_in_contrast,
                          chanlocs     = chanlocs,
                          out_dir      = OUTPUT_DIR)
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat(sprintf("     [WARN] Failed to render %s: %s\n", contrast_name, e$message))
    })
  }

  cat("\n[Done] All contrasts processed.\n")
}
```
